AI voice assistant in the Aeroflot contact center handling passenger calls (flight info, booking, online check-in, ticket purchase) in natural dialogue during trial operation, processing up to 600 calls/day (scaling target ~32,000/day, 600 concurrent dialogs). [Vocamate AI (Prof IT) platform on Sber GigaChat LLM + RAG]

Interactive digital avatar 'Vasilisa' on a touchscreen LED kiosk in airports, using an LLM plus RAG to recognize speech/text and generate answers to common passenger questions 24/7, offloading physical information desks. [none]
Speech analytics applied to customer service, used to analyze contact-center interactions. [AFLT Systems]

Aeroflot and Cloud.ru (AFLT Systems partnership) to build AI-driven passenger services — chatbots, voice assistants, and an operator teleprompter/suggestion tool for the call center — on managed cloud AI to shorten the customer journey and cut routine operator requests. [Cloud.ru / AFLT Systems]

[In-house (Aeroflot / AFLT Systems)]

Neural-network / AI forecasting of demand for specific types of in-flight catering (bortovoe pitanie) to optimize onboard meal provisioning. [none]
